dishes.name: Gentse waterzooi
dishes.desc: Creamy stew of chicken or fish with leek, carrot and potato. Born in Ghent, where chicken has replaced the old river fish.

dishes.name: Gentse neuzen
dishes.desc: Raspberry-flavoured jelly sweets shaped like noses, made in Ghent since the 1800s and sold in the old centre.

dishes.name: Cuberdon
dishes.desc: Cone-shaped purple sweet with a hard shell and runny raspberry centre. Locals call them neuzen, and they are strongly linked to Ghent.

dishes.name: Hutsepot
dishes.desc: Slow-cooked stew of pork and vegetables, a winter dish of Ghent with roots in the 1300s. Still on menus of old taverns.

dishes.name: Tierenteyn mustard
dishes.desc: Strong grainy mustard from a Ghent shop open since 1790, sold from the barrel. Eaten with cold cuts and stoverij.
